name: Unique Dire Rats
body:
Unique Dire Rats
CR 4

XP 1,200
Giant advanced dire rats
N Medium Animals
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 45 (6d8+18 Con)
Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee Bite +7 (1d8+3)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 16, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 4
Base Atk +4; CMB +6; CMD 19 (23 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Natural Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Climb +7, Perception +9, Stealth +11
Languages None

Editor’s Note

This variant Dire Rat was based off of the Dire Rat. The Giant Creature Template was applied, and the creature was advanced five Racial Hit Dice. To match the variant as presented in the Adventure Path, the disease special ability was removed, as was the creature’s swim speed and racial modifiers to skills. These changes resulted in the CR increasing to 4 since it is now slightly more durable than the original.
